description: This file defines an abstract class 'Message' for handling HTTP message components in the AWS CRT PHP SDK. It manages HTTP headers, request methods, paths, and query parameters, including serialization and deserialization to and from blob format.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: An abstract base class representing an HTTP message, providing methods for serialization, deserialization, and access to HTTP components like method, path, query, and headers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Message object with HTTP method, path, query parameters, and headers, and creates an internal native resource.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Releases the native HTTP message resource.

methods.name: toBlob
methods.description: Serializes the HTTP message to a blob suitable for transmission.

methods.name: marshall
methods.description: Converts a Message object into a string buffer for serialization.

methods.name: _unmarshall
methods.description: Creates a Message object from a serialized buffer.

methods.name: pathAndQuery
methods.description: Constructs the request path with encoded query parameters.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Returns the query parameters as a key-value array.
